description: The contract generator, kept apart because it needs a different TypeScript than the application does. openapi-typescript emits its output through the TypeScript compiler's factory API, which the 7.x native port does not expose (`ts.factory` is undefined, and typescript-go's own README lists the API as not ready). It declares `peer typescript@^5.x` and means it. The application is checked by TypeScript 7; this one tool runs on the 5.x it requires, in its own tree, so neither is forced to pretend.
